41.epoque: Psalm 18 was written in a context of war and conflicts, probably during the reign of David, where he had to face many enemies both personally and nationally.

42.epoque: Psalm 18 is attributed to David, a king of Israel who lived around the 10th century B.C., a period marked by military conflicts and struggles for power.

It reminds us that God does not always respond according to our expectations, but according to His wisdom and divine plan. 42.commentaire: This passage invites us to reflect on our own prayer life and our relationship with God. Even when we feel abandoned, it is crucial to persevere in faith and continue to seek God. This verse reminds us that God hears our cries, even if His response may not be immediate or in line with our desires.
